decisions.reason: Removing the complete-video reference-alignment requirement does not necessarily revoke the independently established keyword and wording constraints; the source states no specific change to those constraints.
The source does not change the product benefits, claims, indications, or approved source material, and ending the engagement does not entail different product messaging.
The requirement for realistic native-looking UGC visuals remains semantically independent of whether the complete video follows the reference creative direction.
The deferred landing-page and tracking audit is unrelated to the removed reference-aligned video direction and receives no value or scope change from the source.
